b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line downloader. It fetches the contents of a URL and writes
them to a file or to stdout, retrying on failure.

## CLI options

Run `python -m app.cli --help` for the formatted help. Every option is
documented below with its help text.

### Positional arguments

| Argument | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download |

### Options

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

### Global options

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | show the help message and exit |
'
